S.FORM: 'bagan gluw na kkayal 'tayal hya' ga cyugal qu kkayal na 'tayal qani, 'bagan ga yasa qu kkayal na mqnazi' qani hya', kkayal na malipa' hya' ga nanak maha bagan laha' hya', 'bagan qani hya' ga kkayal naha squ kin ini' ptnaq na kayal qani hya', maha 'ringun ta' squ iyugan kayal qani hya', tyugan kayal hya' ga aring sa ghzyaq balay ka qmisan ha, babaw niya' lga, yasa qu 'ringan tmanguw abaw, ru yasa qu si naha' say maha ttungan abaw la, babaw niya' lga, yasa qu mkilux balay ka 'bagan qani la, hmzinas squ mkilux lga, yasa qu min'aring mzyup squ zik na qmisan ka, mutuw hawqan abaw na qqhuniq, ru yasa qu siy naha' say maha hhawqan abaw qasa hya' la. mkilux na bagan.
S.PHON: ʔβaɣan ɣluw na kkajal ʔtajal ħjaʔ ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]juɣal qu kkajal na ʔtajal qani ʔβaɣan ɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu kkajal na mqnaziʔ qani ħjaʔ kkajal na malipaʔ ħjaʔ ɣa nanak maħa βaɣan laħaʔ ħjaʔ ʔβaɣan qani ħjaʔ ɣa kkajal naħa [s|ɕ]qu kin iniʔ ptnaq na kajal qani ħjaʔ maħa ʔriŋun taʔ [s|ɕ]qu ijuɣan kajal qani ħjaʔ tjuɣan kajal ħjaʔ ɣa ariŋ [s|ɕ]a ɣħzjaq βalaj ka qmi[s|ɕ]an ħa βaβaw nijaʔ lɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu ʔriŋan tmaŋuw aβaw ru ja[s|ɕ]a qu [s|ɕ]i naħaʔ [s|ɕ]aj maħa ttuŋan aβaw la βaβaw nijaʔ lɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu mkilux βalaj ka ʔβaɣan qani la ħmzina[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]qu mkilux lɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu minʔariŋ mzjup [s|ɕ]qu zik na qmi[s|ɕ]an ka mutuw ħawqan aβaw na qqħuniq ru ja[s|ɕ]a qu [s|ɕ]ij naħaʔ [s|ɕ]aj maħa ħħawqan aβaw qa[s|ɕ]a ħjaʔ la mkilux na βaɣan
